mcp.title: Via Claude or ChatGPT (MCP)
mcp.subtitle: Drive Factur-IA from the chat of your AI assistant.
mcp.step1: Copy the URL of the Factur-IA MCP server.
mcp.step2: Add the connector in your assistant:
mcp.step2Sub: Claude — Settings → Connectors · ChatGPT — Settings → Apps & connectors. Paste the URL, that is all — no token to enter.
mcp.step3: Sign in via OAuth with your Factur-IA account in the window that opens.
mcp.step3Sub: Secure access, limited to your account — revocable at any time.
mcp.step4: Ask your assistant, in natural language:

ask.company: "Create my company in Factur-IA: Atelier Quatools, SAS, SIRET 901 234 567 00018."
ask.invoice: "Create an invoice of €2,400 excl. VAT for Studio Méridien."

mcp.realtime: As soon as it is done in Claude, this page moves forward automatically.

notdo.eyebrow: What Factur-IA does not do for you

accounting.title: Keep your books
accounting.desc: Factur-IA is not your accountant. Bookkeeping and the balance sheet remain their job.

decide.title: Decide for you
decide.desc: Your tax and social declarations (VAT, URSSAF) remain your responsibility — check before sending.

legal.title: Guarantee the legal side
legal.desc: The AI prepares, you validate. You remain responsible for the accuracy of the invoiced data.

coffee.title: Make the coffee ☕
coffee.desc: For that, do like everyone else: get an intern. ☕

notdo.note: In short: Factur-IA saves you time, but replaces neither your accountant nor your judgement. You stay in control.
